finding.claim: kmctl init --path takes any path without checking it. A missing directory (a typo such as ../othr-repo) is created silently with mkdir(parents=True) and the run exits 0 reporting four created files. A path that is a file ends in an uncaught NotADirectoryError traceback instead of a one-line error naming the path. Declare the option with exists=True, file_okay=False, dir_okay=True (or check it in init and raise typer.BadParameter), and add a test for both cases.

fixes.change: --path now requires an existing folder (exists=True, file_okay=False), and init prints each scaffold warning to stderr.
Tests for a missing path, a file path, the partial-bundle warnings on stderr, and the warnings field in --json.
